title: Corn-Dog CRAFT: Deluxe Edition

# Welcome to the delightful world of Corn-Dogs™
Corn-Dog CRAFT™ is a horridly balanced, broken, and bs modpack made to be an assortment of mods for me and my friends to play!

![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg) ![CleanroomMC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prrf/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/svgviewer-output.svg) ![noOptiFine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prrf/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/svgviewer-output(1).svg) ![noCurseForge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prrf/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/svgviewer-output(2).svg)
## In Corn-Dog CRAFT™ you will be delighted to find:
1. bad gameplay destroyed by overpowered mods
2. automation mods that dont work together at all
3. cyclic not working with anything other than batteries from itself
4. crafting recipes that make AoA so easy its actually not worth playing
5. atleast 3 different waypoint mods that dont work together
6. a texture pack that changes 3 whole textures
7. insanely good optimization that is completely negated by all of the mods
8. not herobrine
9. nicotine free (but still addictive)

## BYP: BEFORE YOU PLAY
- ### REQUIRES JAVA 21+ FOR CLEANROOM RELAUNCHER
- New recipes are added for lootbags, cobwebs, skill crystals, and more.
- ProjectE "Transmutation" is disabled by default using CraftTweaker
- All stackable items are stackable up to 25 thousand
- Diamond axes and occult pickaxes are stackable up to 25 thousand
- ghost blocks can be a bit buggy especially combined with blocks that deal damage to entites so be careful!
- the game might hang on level save, if this happens wait about a minute and then force close the game. no progress should be lost, if you have any idea why this happens @ me on the twt down below.
